svg.aria-label: CVM entity-relationship diagram. Ten tables grouped into: CVM marker (gray), object graph (objects and relationships, teal), listeners (instance_listeners and class_listeners, purple), execution (processes and frames, green), and frame-attached (frame_locals, frame_delegations, frame_ambers, orange). Foreign keys drawn as curved gray lines with arrowheads. Self-referential foreign keys are noted with (self) inside the table.
svg.title: CVM schema — entity-relationship diagram
